Rep. Smith’s numbers expose the rot: Medicaid’s collapse isn’t partisan—it’s systemic. The CBO’s own data shows 7.5M losing coverage from HR1’s $990B Medicaid cuts, but let’s be clear—this isn’t just “Democrat mismanagement.” The Big Beautiful Bill (HR1) slashes bloated bureaucracies AND forces accountability.

Non-working adults? Fraudsters? Illegals? All symptoms of a broken system that Trump’s reforms are fixing. The real crime? Previous admins let Medicaid become a magnet for waste and lawbreakers.

HR1 redirects funds to Americans who paid in—vets, seniors, workers. Cut the fraud, enforce the law, and watch the system heal.

The numbers don’t lie—see who benefits, who loses, and why the real story is buried in the details: https://t.co/PwaBqDZD8v

Mandate that everyone have insurance (Bronze - Platinum their choice) and have an auto enrollment plan that each state is responsible for administering. At 65 people would transition to Medicare.
